meta.title: GRN–PO Line-Item Auto-Match: refused for a user without the Warehouse Executive role
gaps: Open or execute GRN–PO Line-Item Auto-Match and observe whether it is refused or absent for a user without the Warehouse Executive role.
Repeat the action as a Warehouse Executive and compare availability on the same tenant.
Sign in as the two required personas or inspect tenant RBAC configuration.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open or execute GRN–PO Line-Item Auto-Match and observe whether it is refused or absent for a user without the Warehouse Executive role.; Repeat the action as a Warehouse Executive and compare availability on the same tenant.; Sign in as the two required personas or inspect tenant RBAC configuration.

args.need: sign in on the same tenant as a user without the Warehouse Executive role and as a Warehouse Executive, run GRN–PO Line-Item Auto-Match for each persona, and compare whether the action is refused or absent versus available
